phasedRolloutProposal.phaseA: Expand identity preflight offline across all eligible GDI opportunities with named contacts (no paid search).
phasedRolloutProposal.phaseB: Bounded Gemini LinkedIn discovery only for PARTIAL/UNRESOLVED with verified employer — batch ≤20, budget-capped.
phasedRolloutProposal.phaseC: Airtable idempotent persist + read-back for READY and high-confidence PARTIAL identities.
phasedRolloutProposal.phaseD: Optional controlled Surfe A/B (name+company vs +domain vs +verified LinkedIn) under explicit founder auth.
doNot: Persist Surfe-derived fields into canonical public-contact
Block publication solely for missing LinkedIn

stop: STOP for founder review before additional paid research, full database backfill, or paid Surfe enrichment.
